repo.description:
## Impact

The approval gate in the Send and Wait node's "Approve Within Chat" mode could be bypassed: a resume request could be accepted without the verification that it came from Slack or Telegram, and without the approver allow-list, even where one was configured. Anyone who can see an approval message, with no n8n account or credentials, could advance a waiting execution and trigger the action it guards. Exploitation requires "Approve Within Chat" already in use on a publicly reachable HTTPS instance, and sight of the approval request for the execution targeted.

## Patches

The issue has been fixed in n8n versions 2.40.1 and 2.39.6. Users should upgrade to one of these versions or later to remediate the vulnerability.

## Workarounds

If upgrading is not immediately possible, administrators should consider the following temporary mitigations:
- Restrict n8n instance access to fully trusted users only.
- Avoid using the "Approve Within Chat" mode for Send and Wait nodes that gate high-consequence actions until the instance is patched.
- Limit membership of the Telegram or Slack channels used for approvals to the minimum set of trusted users.

These workarounds do not fully remediate the risk and should only be used as short-term mitigation measures.
repo.summary: Approval Bypass in the Send and Wait Node's Approve Within Chat Mode
